title: Controlled Artifact Reimport Foundation
goal: Close the supervised Codex build-lane loop by adding a controlled import path from validated workspace artifacts back into reviewed pack artifacts.
scope: Implement or reconcile the first controlled artifact reimport slice for Codex-prepared validation results and generated pack artifacts. The path must preserve pack review, validation, approval, deployment, and runtime binding gates.
generation_reason: Backlog refresh requested by the project owner after the previous queue ended at backlog item 10.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only add a controlled reimport path. Do not bypass pack validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding.
notes: Reimported artifacts must stay reviewable and traceable.
Runtime packs must not change during active assessments.

success_criteria: Validated Codex workspace output can be imported or staged through a controlled pack artifact path.
The existing pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, and runtime binding gates remain authoritative.
Invalid or missing validation-result data is rejected clearly.
API and docs cover the supported reimport flow.
must_not_touch: runtime pack binding behavior during active runs

acceptance_criteria: Reimport preserves all existing pack gates.
No runtime pack changes occur outside the deployment/binding flow.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
Existing Codex export and validation-result handoff behavior is understood and documented.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with artifact reimport changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the Codex build-lane reimport baseline and remaining limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
